name: vector
description: Vector layer, as in Moho: it holds parts (paths, each with its fill and stroke) that draw in their order, the last one on top. Every shape is a path: the Rectangle and Ellipse tools draw paths too. Points of its parts can be named ("jaw.chin"), shared between parts (welded) and gathered in point groups.
help: Vector layer: holds the drawing (parts with fill and stroke).

groups.description: Point groups: { "upper_lid": ["lid.top", "brow.mid"] }, each a list of named points ("part.point") of this layer's parts, to pick, move or bind them together. null = none.
groups.help: Groups of named points of this layer's parts.
